completion: After the credited physical pass kick, the intended teammate exclusively holds the ball at its mouth for at least 0.20 s, following travel of at least 0.55 m within 4 s. An opponent or unintended teammate touching with its mouth ends the pass.
scope: Six mobile robots, symmetric possession tactics and a 12-second shot clock. Randomized tactical restarts after goal, out or clock expiry. Learned receiver choice and frozen learned pass motor, with geometric movement, support, defensive and shooting tactics.
